1) patient-reported outcomes, including the Functional Assessment of Cancer Therapy (FACT)-Multiple Myeloma (MM), are associated with survival in patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myleoma; and 2) the addition of patient-reported outcomes (including FACT-MM) to clinical data improves prognostic accuracy in this patient population.

patient-reported outcomes are useful for describing patients' experiences and are predictive of outcomes in patients with multiple myeloma treated with bortezomibs.
